newsitem.title: USA: Wells-Gardner says $1 mln in sales delayed.
newsitem.headline: Wells-Gardner says $1 mln in sales delayed.

text.p: Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp said Tuesday about $1.0 million of sales that had been scheduled for delivery in the third quarter were delayed until the fourth quarter.
"We fully expect these sales, which are to several of our largest and most reliable customers, will be delivered in October and November," Anthony Spier, chairman, said in a statement.

Earlier, Wells-Gardner, which makes monitors for amusement, gaming, leisure and fitness, automotive and video wall markets, reported a third quarter profit of $0.04 a share. A year ago, it reported a loss of $0.18 a share.
Margins were 17.2 percent in this third quarter, compared to 13.7 percent in the prior period.
Wells-Gardner said that 70 percent of 1996 sales are from products released since the middle of 1994.
